name: Maja and Benny
detailed_description:
The story of a little girl named Maja, who meets a little cat named Benny in the forest. Where did he come from? You'll find out over time. The two characters find themselves in a mysterious town. It turns out that... the trees there have dreams, just like the teddy bear and the paper lion. The people they meet also have different dreams and wishes, and not everything seems as it should be. The windmill dreams of wind—but where and how can they find it? The hamster dreams of a sunflower and a spinning wheel, and the seal dreams of a ball. Where did the seal come from? Good question!

In town, Maja and Benny meet many different people (including a busy math teacher and a lost little boy), many animals, and many... other characters they wouldn't expect to be alive. After all, can a bicycle live? Or a house? Apparently, yes.

Will Maja and Benny uncover the town's secret? This will require them to not only explore the town's various locations and inhabitants, but that's not all. There's also a snowy land, an underwater world, a desert, and a distant planet to discover (a spacesuit would be handy, right? A little hint: one of the townspeople knows something about it). And these are just a few of their adventures.

As the story unfolds, you'll meet new characters and learn more about Maya and Benny. Will you successfully complete all the missions, uncover all the secrets, and help all the heroes? Let's hope so.

So get to know Maya and Benny better, help the townspeople (or is it really just them?), and explore various lands and worlds. Help the charming girl and her cat solve mysteries and logical puzzles and reach the destination of their exciting journey. Good luck!
